project.name: PROYECTO ASOCIATIVO PROGRAMÁTICO ZONA ANDINA Y COSTA ATLÁNTICA - FCG
project.description: An Associative project combines multiple instances or phases (project areas) of project activity into a single combined initiative over a defined period of time. Through grouping, it allows the linking of actors of all types of scale (mainly medium and small) since it allows validation of all areas of the project in different phases or instances, later inclusion with the same eligibility and additionality criteria defined from the begining of the project for new instances. This allows projects to expand over time in the initially defined geographical area and thus reduce transaction costs, becoming an inclusive mechanism for small and medium-sized reforesters.
project.quantification_method: CDM - AR-ACM0003: Afforestation and reforestation of lands except wetlands

project.name: MYERS-TINDLE UNIT 12C
project.description: The Myers-Tindle Unit 12C is a gas well that was drilled into the Barnett Shale formation in 2005. The well pad is located on the northern side of the growing and increasingly urban and suburban Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex. While this wells' best producing days are long gone, there was still a signifant quantity of gas that it could have produced for years to come. However, instead of continuing to produce this well, we have permanently plugged this well to avoid commingling with the urban growth and to make room for new land use opportunities. Because of our permanent plugging procedure, those hydrocarbons will never be produced and combusted nor released into the atmosphere.
